name: browser-automation-studio.do-task
purpose: Execute an authorized exact workflow or bounded navigation, independently verify requested postconditions, return bounded task output and durable feedback references.

task.description: The browser task in plain words; also the navigation prompt.

scenario.description: Scenario under test; used to key site-note entries.

session.description: Existing browser session id; without it the navigation fallback is skipped.

model.description: Vision model identifier, required when `session` is given (navigation fallback). Never defaulted: callers must not hardcode a model slug.

navigation_id.description: Resume a navigation started earlier (from signals.navigation_id) instead of starting one; mutually exclusive with session, workflow_id and flow.

wait_millis.description: Server-side bounded wait for the navigation to reach a terminal state, 0..300000. 0 reads status once; a reached navigation is authored and verified in the same run only when the wait allowed it to finish.

advice_attempt_id.description: The signals.learning.attempt_id of the search run whose recommendation this execution follows; a verified or failed outcome grades that run supported or contradicted through learn.feedback.

postconditions.description: Independent typed BAS assertion parameters defining task success; no synthetic body-exists fallback.

qualify.description: Authorize one authored ad hoc run plus one execution of the persisted revision so a reached navigation can become a durable verified workflow. Repeats the task's effects; requires postconditions.

auto_select.description: Select only explicitly authorized exact revisions; requires postconditions.

authorized_workflows.description: Authorized workflow_id@version values; recommendation alone grants no authority.

effect_policy.description: explicit uses existing task authority; read_only rejects navigator actions other than wait/done before execution.

profile_id.description: Opaque account/profile compatibility identity, never credentials.

advice_feedback_ref.description: Durable reference from an earlier recommendation for delayed feedback.

extraction.description: At most 16 named final-page DOM extractions {name, selector, attribute?, limit?}; at most 32768 output bytes.

assumptions: Caller selects an authorized exact workflow version or supplies an authorized candidate/session
Runtime captures the outcome automatically and suppresses nested duplicate attempts
Learning identity includes site, normalized task, profile, environment, and result contract; options identify exact workflow revisions
invariants: One execution route, no speculative candidate execution or retry
No raw screenshots in the envelope; bounded candidate flows and requested task output remain available to the caller
Runtime owns one automatic outcome capture for the selected task
A failed revision is noted as avoid so the next recommendation excludes it
Automatic selection is restricted to explicitly authorized exact revisions.
A navigation trace never verifies the flow rebuilt from it; qualification requires explicit caller authorization, declared postconditions, and an independent execution of the persisted revision.
Qualification never downgrades a task that already verified on the live page, and a qualified revision earns its preference from the same child and postconditions the reuse route uses.

bindings.note: Called with rows="entries"; unreadable timeline degrades the class to step_failed.
Called with rows="ranked" (the response has four repeated fields).

signals.candidates: At most five selection candidates, each with id and version when runnable_by_id
signals.recommended_workflow: On search: {workflow_id, version, option_id, source(advice|default), why[]} from learn.choose over remembered preferences and avoids
signals.learning: Durable feedback_ref identifies this task or exact artifact for later learn.feedback.
signals.navigation_id: Navigation started or resumed; pass back as navigation_id to resume
signals.outcome: unknown unless the child explicitly reports failed/unavailable or verified_success with an ok status and evidence; completed navigation is not verification
signals.reused_workflow: Whether the selected route used an existing workflow
signals.output: Named arrays extracted from the final page; bounded to 32768 bytes.
signals.qualification: candidate when a recorded flow was not qualified; qualified when the persisted revision independently verified the task postconditions
signals.qualified_workflow: {workflow_id, version} persisted from a reached navigation under qualify=true, before independent verification
signals.replay_eligible: true only after the persisted revision verified the task postconditions in its own execution

outputs.evidence: execution:<id> per attempt, navigation:<id> when the fallback ran

budget.async_reason: wall_ms exceeds the 120 s synchronous bound: submit with --async and wait once.
